newsitem.title: FRANCE: Traders seek confirmation of Algerian maize deal.
newsitem.headline: Traders seek confirmation of Algerian maize deal.

text.p: Algeria appeared to have purchased 43,000 tonnes of maize for March 1-10 shipment, but the deal has yet to be confirmed, European grain traders said on Wednesday.
Exporters said Algeria on Tuesday might have bought 15,000 tonnes of U.S. maize and 28,000 tonnes of Argentine and/or Brazilian maize.
One exporter cited a selling price of under $140 per tonne, cost and freight, for the Argentine/and/or Brazilian maize while another put the pricetag at around $139 per tonne.
Pricing details for the U.S. maize were not available. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
